situation: A zh-TW issue quotes the bot's expected replies in 「」 but typed them with half-width punctuation (, : ( )), while the bot's existing replies use full-width (，：（）)
right_direction: Keep each quoted sentence in the regression exactly as typed (the verbatim check needs it), map only the half-width marks to the bot's full-width ones in one declared translate table, and prove the mapping with the filer's own quote of a reply that must stay unchanged (e.g. 已加入 摩卡 × 3,目前合計 → today's 已加入 摩卡 × 3，目前合計); say the mapping in the report so the filer can ask for literal half-width
anti_pattern: Either copying the half-width marks into the bot so one reply breaks the house style, or retyping the quotes in full-width in the test so the verbatim check no longer finds the filer's wording
source_quote: 輸入「點 摩卡 3杯」(沒有客製),行為與現在完全相同,回覆「已加入 摩卡 × 3,目前合計 NT$XXX」。
